alex.sre: Quick heads-up — regional resilience rehearsal + degraded-mode run next Wed 2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll simulate increased inter-AZ latency in west-1 and validate our graceful-degrade paths (model tiering, KV cache fallback, and routing fallbacks). Expected: brief p99 spike for a subset of requests, no planned customer-facing errors. Rollback playbook is ready.

sre_jen: Clarify — will Private (VPC/on-prem) customers be impacted?

alex.sre: Private deployments will NOT be touched by default. Only platform-managed infra (Hosted + Dedicated GPU pools) are in scope. Dedicated: we'll run a small canary first.

patrick.ops: @oncall can you get +1 extra pager during the window? I'd like someone dedicated to routing telemetry. :eyes: 

oncall: I can cover it. Recommend we start at 5% canary and pause if early noise > threshold.

alex.sre: Plan overview: 1) Canary 5% for 30m, 2) Ramp to 25% for 45m, 3) Sweep to target for 45m, 4) Cooldown 20m. Rollback triggers: error rate delta >3% OR sustained p99 delta >200ms for 10m. Runbook excerpt below.

alex.sre: ```
# kick off canary (example)
./infra-maint schedule --region west-1 --percent 5 --start 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z 
  --profile degraded-mode --script simulate-network-lag
```

maria.platform: Do we need to adjust SLO calculations/alerting to avoid noisy burns?

alex.sre: Yes — alerts will be muted via the runbook for the exact window and the SLO burn calculator will ignore the rehearsal window when computing weekly burn. We'll publish a short SLO-impact summary after the run.

dina.r&d: Any expected impact to streaming or function/tool-calls?

alex.sre: Streaming could see extra jitter on affected paths; function/tool calls are expected to remain functional with slightly higher tail latency. KV-cache warmup is part of the ramp to reduce long-term impact.

ops-bot: Maintenance created: mtn-20260401-01 (https://infra.redwood.example/mtn/mtn-20260401-01)

jamie.prod: Thanks — please cc Product on the postmortem and prepare a short customer blurb if we hit >0.5% customer-visible errors.

alex.sre: Will do. Full runbook will be posted in #eng-sre-runbooks and I'll ping integrators and support 24h before. Tagging @oncall, @maria.platform, and @patrick.ops for visibility. :thumbsup:
